sources.title: Text-to-image Diffusion Models in Generative AI: A Survey
sources.snippet: Abstract This survey reviews the progress of diffusion models in generating images from text, i.e. text-to-image diffusion models. As a self-contained work, this survey starts with a brief introduction of how diffusion models work for image synthesis, followed by the background for text-conditioned image synthesis.
